items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He came in about a year later, and we turned it into a quartet.

ctx.x: When I was in Miles’ band, Dave Holland and I had a growing affinity for playing together, and playing freely together. It becomes obvious when you watch and listen to that quintet, which is now being released more...you can check that quintet out... There was some pretty loose, free improvisation within that group. When Dave and I saw that Miles was wanting to go in a different direction rhythmically and so forth, there was the parting of the ways. Dave and I were still highly interested in free improvisation,…
He came in about a year later, and we turned it into a quartet. Then we started writing little sketches and little pieces.
